SECTION: PROGRAM: Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Sciences | College: College of Teacher Education (CTE) | Degree: Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd) | Major: Sciences
PROGRAM: Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Sciences
College: College of Teacher Education (CTE)
Degree: Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd)
Major: Sciences
Duration: 4 years

Overview: A teacher-education program specializing in general science content and pedagogy, including laboratory instruction, preparing graduates to teach science in junior/senior high school.

Skills developed:
- Science Teaching Methodology and Laboratory Instruction
- Subject-Area Teaching Pedagogy
- Curriculum Planning and Classroom Instruction

Career and job outcomes:
- High School Science Teacher: Teaches science subjects in junior/senior high school after passing the Licensure Examination for Teachers.

Admission requirement:
- Minimum General Weighted Average (GWA): 90.0
- Note: CTE additionally requires no grade lower than 85 in English, Mathematics, and Science.

Board/licensure status:
- Board program. Graduates may take the Licensure Examination for Teachers (Secondary Level).

Regulatory basis (CHED): CMO No. 75, s. 2017 - Policies, Standards and Guidelines for Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd)
